recognize_zh: CD20 染色下外套層與生發中心皆為 B 細胞而呈棕色陽性，擴張的外套層形成大片一致的陽性區，只有濾泡間的纖細條帶為陰性（T 細胞區），標示出外套層擴張的範圍。
features: Diffuse membranous CD20 staining of large nodular areas corresponding to expanded mantle zones
Germinal centers also CD20-positive, with slightly larger cells and stronger staining
Thin CD20-negative interfollicular bands representing T-cell zones and vessels
Nodular architecture with near-confluence of adjacent nodules
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows strong membranous staining of nearly all cells within large nodules composed of expanded mantle zones and their residual germinal centers, separated by thin CD20-negative interfollicular septa. The B-cell population thus accounts for the mantle zone expansion. Although CD20 does not discriminate neoplastic from reactive B cells, in conjunction with CD5, cyclin D1 and SOX11 co-expression the findings support mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone pattern.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are CD10+ BCL2+ in germinal-center-like nodules and are CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative.
Reactive follicles have normal-width polarized mantles with polytypic B cells lacking CD5 and cyclin D1.
MZL shows CD20+ perifollicular marginal zone expansion but is CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative.
